chunks: It is narrated from the righteous servant, Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both), who said:

"Recite this supplication in the month of Ramadan at the beginning of the year." He mentioned, "Whoever recites it sincerely and with intention will not be afflicted in that year with tribulation or calamity in his religion, worldly affairs, or body, and Allah will protect him from the harm of what comes in that year.

O Allah, I ask You by Your Name to which all things yield, by Your mercy that encompasses all things, by Your might through which You overpower all things, by Your greatness to which all things humble themselves, by Your strength to which all things submit, by Your dominion that surpasses all things, and by Your knowledge that "encompasses all things." O Light, O Holy One, O the First before all things and the Remaining after all things, O Allah, O Merciful, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

And forgive me the sins that change blessings, and forgive me the sins that bring down vengeance, and forgive me the sins that cut off hope, and forgive me the sins that bring adversaries near, and forgive me the sins that repel supplication, and forgive me the sins that bring down tribulations, and forgive me the sins that withhold the rains of the sky, and forgive me the sins that tear apart protections.
And clothe me in Your impenetrable armor, which cannot be pierced, and grant me well-being from the harm of what I fear by night and by day in the coming year of mine.

O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths and what is within them and between them, and Lord of the Great Throne, and Lord of the Seven Oft-Repeated Verses and the Magnificent Quran, and Lord of Israfil, Mika'il, and Jibril, and Lord of Muhammad, master of the messengers and seal of the prophets.

I ask You by You and by what You have named Yourself, O Magnificent. You are the One who bestows great blessings, averts all feared calamities, grants abundant rewards, multiplies abundant good deeds from little, and does whatever You will.
O All-Powerful, O Allah, O Merciful, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

And clothe me in the coming year of mine with Your protection, and illuminate my face with Your light, and enliven me with Your love, and bring me to Your satisfaction, the honor of Your noble gifts, and the greatness of Your bounties from the best of what is with You and from the best of what You bestow upon anyone of Your creation.

And clothe me with that, along with it, in Your well-being, O the One who hears every complaint and witnesses every whispered prayer and knows every secret, and the One who wards off what You will from affliction, O Generous in forgiveness, O the One who perfects pardon.

Cause me to die upon the creed of Ibrahim and his natural disposition, and upon the religion of Muhammad and his Sunnah, and upon the best of fates. So cause me to die as a supporter of Your friends and an enemy of Your adversaries.

O Allah, protect me in this year from every action or speech or deed that distances me from You, and bring me closer to every action or deed or speech that brings me closer to You in this year, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

And prevent me from every action or deed or speech of mine that I fear will lead to an evil consequence or earn Your wrath upon me, lest You turn away Your noble face from me and I incur a diminution of my portion with You, O Most Compassionate, O Most Merciful.

O Allah, place me in the coming year of mine in Your protection, under Your care, and in Your shelter. Envelop me in the shield of Your well-being and bestow upon me Your honor. Exalted is Your might, and glorified is Your praise. There is no deity other than You.

O Allah, make me among those who follow the righteous who have passed away among Your friends and join me with them. Make me submissive to those who truly proclaim the truth about You among them. And I seek refuge in You.

O my God, from my sins enveloping me, from my injustices, my excesses upon myself, my following of my desires, and my preoccupation with my passions, so that a barrier is placed between me and Your mercy and pleasure, so I become forgotten by You, exposed to Your wrath and punishment.
O Allah, guide me to every righteous deed that You are pleased with from me and bring me closer to You with proximity.

O Allah, as You protected Your Prophet Muhammad—Your blessings be upon him and his family—from the horrors of his enemies, alleviated his worries, removed his distress, fulfilled Your promise to him, and honored Your covenant with him.
O Allah, therefore by that, protect me from the hardships, afflictions, illnesses, trials, evils, sorrows, and financial difficulties of this year.
And bring me, by Your mercy, to complete well-being through the continuity of Your blessings upon me until the end of my appointed term.

I ask You the request of one who has erred, wronged, submitted, and confessed, that You forgive me what has passed of the sins which Your guardians witnessed and Your noble angels recorded and counted against me.
And that You shield me, O Allah, from the sins for what remains of my life until the end of my appointed term.

O Allah, O Merciful, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and give me everything I asked You for and hoped for from You, for You commanded me to supplicate and guaranteed the response. O Most Merciful of the merciful.

key_terms.مُسْتَقْبِلَ دُخُولِ السَّنَةِ: At the beginning of the year

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for the beginning of the year in Ramadan according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih*, this supplication is traditionally recited on the first day of Ramadan to inaugurate the year with spiritual vigilance. It emphasizes the efficacy of sincere devotion (*muhtasiban mukhlisan*) in warding off *fitan* (tribulations) and *afat* (calamities), while invoking divine attributes to secure protection for one's religion, worldly life, and physical health.
